title: Mint Book
tagline: Mint Book is a collaborative project where users can contribute notes to create a unique book. Once completed, it can be minted as an NFT. Collaborators earn royalties upon sale. Connect your wallet, add your thoughts, and be part of this innovative project!
description:
Project Overview: Mint Book is an interactive platform that allows multiple users to contribute notes and ideas to a collaborative book project. Once the book is complete, it can be minted as an NFT. When sold, all contributors earn royalties, creating a rewarding collaborative experience.

How It Works:

Connect Wallet:
Users click the "Connect Wallet" button to link their Rainbow Wallet to the platform.

Add Notes:
After wallet connection, a text description area appears where users can input relevant notes or ideas for the book.

Collaboration:
Multiple users can add their contributions, enriching the book with diverse perspectives.

Minting:
Once all collaborators have submitted their content, the completed book can be minted as an NFT.

Royalty Distribution:
Upon sale of the minted book, all contributors receive a share of the royalties, incentivizing collaboration and creativity.
how_its_made:
This project uses following Tech stack:

Next.js: For building the user interface and handling server-side rendering.
Hard Hat: For smart contract development and deployment on the Ethereum blockchain.
Rainbow Wallet: For user wallet integration and transaction handling.
MongoDB: For storing user contributions and project data efficiently.
